description: PCF8574 I2C GPIO expander breakout powered from 3.3 V, with 4.7k I2C pull-ups, 100 nF decoupling, and address selection jumpers for A0-A2. The eight GPIO pins and I2C bus connect via headers. Name the nets VCC, GND, SCL, SDA, A0, A1, A2 and P0 through P7.
topic: sensor and interface breakouts with pull-ups, level setting and decoupling

description: A 5 V logic input protection board that clamps the signal to the 0-5 V rails using two 1N4148 diodes (one to VCC, one to GND) and a 1k series resistor, limiting the output to about -0.7 V to 5.7 V for a downstream 5 V input. Input and output on 2-pin headers, powered from the 5 V rail. Name the nets VCC, GND, IN and OUT.
topic: protection circuits (reverse polarity, clamping with zeners or diodes)

description: Reverse-polarity protection for a 12 V, 2 A load using an N-channel MOSFET in the ground return path, with a 10k gate resistor to VIN and a 15 V zener from gate to source to keep VGS within rating. Input and output on 2-pin screw terminals, with the load connected between VOUT and the protected ground. Name the nets VIN, VOUT and GND.
topic: protection circuits (reverse polarity, clamping with zeners or diodes)

description: Overvoltage disconnect for a 24 V, 1 A input using a P-channel MOSFET with a 15 V zener from gate to source, so the output turns off when the input exceeds about 16 V. Input and output on 2-pin screw terminals. Name the nets VIN, VOUT and GND.
topic: protection circuits (reverse polarity, clamping with zeners or diodes)

description: RS-485 bus protection board using an SM712 TVS array to clamp the A and B lines to within -7 V to +12 V, with 10 ohm series resistors on each line. Bus input and protected output on 2-pin screw terminals, with a ground pin. Name the nets A_IN, B_IN, A_OUT, B_OUT and GND.
topic: protection circuits (reverse polarity, clamping with zeners or diodes)

description: Reverse-polarity protection for a 12 V, 1 A input using a Schottky diode across the input (cathode to VIN) and a 1 A fuse in series, so reverse polarity shorts the supply and blows the fuse. Input and output on 2-pin headers. Name the nets VIN, VOUT and GND.
topic: protection circuits (reverse polarity, clamping with zeners or diodes)

description: Input protection for a +/-12 V op-amp stage that clamps the signal to the supply rails using two 1N4148 diodes and a 10k series resistor, protecting the op-amp from inputs up to +/-30 V. Input, output and power on pin headers. Name the nets IN, OUT, VPOS (+12 V), VNEG (-12 V) and GND.
topic: protection circuits (reverse polarity, clamping with zeners or diodes)

description: Reverse-polarity protection for a 5 V, 500 mA USB VBUS input using a P-channel MOSFET with its gate tied to GND, giving a low drop of about 50 mV. VBUS input and protected output on 2-pin headers. Name the nets VBUS, VOUT and GND.
topic: protection circuits (reverse polarity, clamping with zeners or diodes)

description: Power ORing board that combines two 5 V, 500 mA supplies into one output using two Schottky diodes, preventing one supply from back-feeding the other. Both inputs and the output on 2-pin headers. Name the nets VIN1, VIN2, VOUT and GND.
topic: protection circuits (reverse polarity, clamping with zeners or diodes)

description: RS-232 input protection that clamps a +/-12 V signal to 0-5 V TTL levels using a 5.1 V zener to GND and a 10k series resistor, with a 100 nF filter capacitor. RS-232 input on a 2-pin header and TTL output on a 2-pin header. Name the nets RS232_IN, TTL_OUT and GND.
topic: protection circuits (reverse polarity, clamping with zeners or diodes)
